name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: What to know about Pickaxe Mountain, an Iranian target noted by Trump
changes.summary: President Trump on Tuesday threatened to attack Pickaxe Mountain in Iran, a secure facility allegedly used for nuclear activity. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean has more.

changes.title: With His Latest Threats, Trump Signals to Iran That He Is Willing to Escalate
changes.summary: President Trump is facing a critical moment in the war, which has failed to bring about the “unconditional surrender” he once demanded.

changes.title: Trump ally Andy Biggs wins GOP nomination for Arizona governor, AP projects
changes.summary: Trump-endorsed Rep. Andy Biggs will take on Democratic Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs in November.

changes.title: Trump-backed Jay Feely wins GOP primary in Arizona’s battleground 1st District
changes.summary: Former Arizona Cardinals kicker Jay Feely cruised to victory in Arizona’s 1st District on Tuesday, one of the nation’s most competitive battlegrounds. Feely, a close ally of President Donald Trump, leveraged Trump’s endorsement to topple former state Rep. Joseph Chaplik. He’ll face a steep challenge defeating the Democ.

changes.title: The top of Arizona’s GOP ticket is littered with 2020 election deniers
changes.summary: To make it out of a Republican primary in Arizona, there’s one key litmus test: believing the 2020 election was stolen from Donald Trump. Election deniers who played prominent roles in efforts to overturn the 2020 results triumphed in statewide Republican primaries Tuesday, from Rep. Andy Biggs for governor to state Re.

changes.title: 6 Takeaways From Arizona’s Tense, Trump-Dominated Primaries
changes.summary: Republicans nominated a former N.F.L. kicker in a top House battleground, a Trump loyalist for governor and an election denier for the state’s top election post.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Funding cuts and program changes required by President Trump's big budget law are forcing states to rethink bipartisan efforts to bring Medicaid into jails and prisons. (Image credit: Ramon Dompor for Tradeoffs).

changes.title: Trump-backed candidates, 2020 election deniers, win Arizona primaries
changes.summary: The primaries set the field for what are expected to be heated contests for Congress and governor in a swing state this fall. (Image credit: Ross D. Franklin).

changes.title: Trump has campaigned more so far in 2026 midterms than he did at this point in 2018
changes.summary: Heading to Georgia on Wednesday, President Trump is campaigning more often this year than he did in the same period for 2018 and has already rallied for a dozen candidates in toss-up races. (Image credit: Roberto Schmidt).

changes.title: Laredo’s Future Rides on Trump’s Next Trade Move
changes.summary: The economy of Laredo, Texas, has boomed under the president’s global tariffs. Now, his demands may threaten its success.
